svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.9.4 Spacing and Joints
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING

g.text: Spaced shingles with the joints staggered, (1)
Red dashed line: a joint carried up two courses lands on a shingle, not a joint

svg.text: apart and offset at the joints in adjacent
courses not less than 40 mm (1 9/16″) so that
joints in alternate courses are staggered.
Drawn: 400 mm shingles at a 125 mm exposure, widths 90 to 300 mm. The plan is cut at the top. Widths and joint positions are illustration only.
